name: score-keeper
description: Live scoreboards, five-dice score sheets, and 501/301 darts legs with checkout suggestions.

interface.longDescription:
For game-night entertainment, Gamechalk Score Keeper offers a live scoreboard, five-dice score sheet scoring, and a 301 or 501 darts scorer. Open a board for 2–12 players with highest-score, lowest-score, or first-to-target modes; adjust points with plus/minus controls, view the leader, and use history and undo for the last 20 actions. Change the scoring step with the Smaller step and Bigger step buttons.

Score thirteen dice categories, the 35-point upper bonus at 63 or more, and eligible 100-point repeat five-of-a-kind bonuses. Provide play_order for the roll chronology; when omitted, the tool assumes the listed category order from ones through chance. A full house requires a distinct triple and pair; eligible repeats use joker scoring when the matching upper category is filled.

Darts input uses S1–S20, D1–D20, T1–T20, SB, DB, or 0 for a miss. The result includes turn scores, busts, remaining points, a three-dart average, and a computed shortest checkout under the chosen out rule. Dice sheets and darts legs include CSV downloads. Scores stay in the open widget only. No online multiplayer; darts starts are limited to 301 and 501.
defaultPrompt: Show a highest-score scoreboard for Anna and Ben, starting at 25 and 0.
Score a 501 double-out darts leg: T20 T20 T20; T20 T20 T20; T20 T19 D12.
Score my five-dice sheet: ones [1,1,2,3,4], full_house [5,5,5,2,2], chance [3,4,4,5,6].

positive.prompt: Show a highest-score scoreboard for Anna and Ben, starting at 25 and 0.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls show_scoreboard for Anna and Ben in highest mode, starting at 25 and 0. The widget shows point controls, the leader, undo, and round history.

positive.prompt: Tally my dice sheet: ones [1,1,2,3,4], twos [2,2,3,4,5], threes [3,3,4,5,6], fours [4,4,4,5,6], fives [5,5,6,6,6], sixes [4,6,6,6,6], three_of_a_kind [3,3,4,5,6], four_of_a_kind [4,4,4,5,6], full house [5,5,5,2,2], five_of_a_kind [2,2,2,2,2], chance [3,4,4,5,6]
positive.expected_behavior: Calls score_dice_sheet with the supplied rolls. Upper total 58, upper bonus 0, total 155. The CSV downloads the scored categories.

positive.prompt: Score a 501 double-out darts leg: T20 T20 T20; T20 T20 T20; T20 T19 D12.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls score_darts_leg with double-out on. The finish uses 9 darts, remaining 0, three-dart average 167. A CSV contains the turn results.

positive.prompt: Score a 301 double-out darts leg: five turns of S20 S20 S20, then S1.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls score_darts_leg. The leave-one turn busts; remaining 60, busts 1. Later darts in a bust turn are ignored.

positive.prompt: Score a 301 double-out darts leg: T20 T20 T20; T20 S11; DB.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls score_darts_leg. The DB finish leaves 0 after 6 darts.

negative.expected_behavior: The plugin scores games; it does not give coaching advice or rules lessons.

negative.prompt: Keep track of our poker chips and bets
negative.expected_behavior: The plugin keeps game scores only; it is not for money, wagers, or betting, and it does not handle payments.

negative.prompt: Scoreboard for 13 players named Player A through Player M.
negative.expected_behavior: The scoreboard supports 2–12 players and rejects a larger game with a plain input error.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Live scoreboard, five-dice sheet scoring, darts scoring, and CSV downloads.

pl-PL.subtitle: Wyniki gier, kości i rzutek
pl-PL.description: Tablica wyników dla 2–12 graczy, arkusz pięciu kości oraz punktacja rzutek 301/501. Dostępne są cofanie zmian, historia i pliki CSV. Wyniki pozostają w otwartym widżecie; brak gry online.

de-DE.subtitle: Spielstände, Würfel und Darts
de-DE.description: Punktetafel für 2–12 Personen, Auswertung von fünf Würfeln und Darts mit 301/501. Mit Rückgängig, Verlauf und CSV-Dateien. Spielstände bleiben im geöffneten Widget; kein Online-Mehrspielermodus.

es-ES.subtitle: Marcador, dados y dardos
es-ES.description: Marcador para 2–12 jugadores, hoja de cinco dados y puntuación de dardos 301/501. Incluye deshacer, historial y archivos CSV. Los puntos permanecen en el widget abierto; sin multijugador en línea.

fr-FR.subtitle: Scores, dés et fléchettes
fr-FR.description: Tableau de scores pour 2 à 12 joueurs, feuille de cinq dés et fléchettes 301/501. Avec annulation, historique et fichiers CSV. Les scores restent dans le widget ouvert ; pas de multijoueur en ligne.

ja-JP.subtitle: ゲーム・サイコロ・ダーツの得点
ja-JP.description: 2〜12人のスコアボード、5個のサイコロの得点表、301/501ダーツの得点計算。取り消し、履歴、CSV出力に対応。得点は開いているウィジェット内に保持され、オンライン対戦には対応しません。

pt-BR.subtitle: Placar, dados e dardos
pt-BR.description: Placar para 2–12 jogadores, folha de cinco dados e pontuação de dardos 301/501. Inclui desfazer, histórico e arquivos CSV. Os pontos ficam no widget aberto; sem multijogador online.
